from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Core identifying info from one judgment document: its title and stated case cause."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The judgment document's title as written")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Case category: civil, criminal, or administrative")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the cause of action")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
